newsitem.title: INDONESIA: ASEAN to call for ceasefire in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN to call for ceasefire in Cambodia.

text.p: The seven members of the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) will issue a joint call for a ceasefire in Cambodia on Tuesday, Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said.
He also confirmed a report by Malaysia's Bernama news agency that ASEAN foreign ministers would meet in Kuala Lumpur on Thursday for a special session on Cambodia.
"ASEAN will issue a joint statement calling for a ceasefire," Alatas told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
The statement follows fighting in Cambodia between bitterly opposed factions that has brought the battered country to the brink of civil war.
Cambodia, together with Burma and Laos, was due to join ASEAN later this month, but the latest situation has cast doubt on whether this will go ahead as scheduled.

Alatas said the foreign ministers would "evaluate all aspects of the recent developments in Cambodia" at their meeting in the Malaysian capital. Malaysia is the current chairman of ASEAN, which also groups Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines and Brunei.
